subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` source opt-out for built-in skill roots, and should that API be a typed source list or a narrower personal `.agents/skills` toggle?
rationale: The requested fix adds public config surface and changes built-in skill-source behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and product-owned.

options.title: Approve typed source-disable config
options.body: Add a narrow `skills.load.disableSources`-style field for stable built-in source IDs and apply it before loader and watcher registration while preserving current defaults.

options.title: Approve personal-only toggle
options.body: Add a smaller boolean for `~/.agents/skills` only, reducing public surface but making future source opt-outs require another config decision.

options.title: Decline new config
options.body: Keep current discovery and direct users to per-agent allowlists, prompt limits, and per-skill disables even though those do not prevent scanning.

recommendation.title: Approve typed source-disable config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `skills.load.disableSources`-style field for stable built-in source IDs and apply it before loader and watcher registration while preserving current defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows this account actively owning the skills discovery, watcher, and docs surface most affected by the decision.
